----

scrcpy v3.3.4 (Windows release) ships the following third-party components
inside the scrcpy/ folder of this distribution. The exact upstream versions
and build scripts are pinned by scrcpy's app/deps directory:
https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/tree/v3.3.4/app/deps
(no patches are applied to these sources).

  * FFmpeg 7.1.1 (avcodec-61.dll, avformat-61.dll, avutil-59.dll,
    swresample-5.dll), copyright (c) the FFmpeg developers.
    Licensed under the GNU LGPL v2.1 or later (built without GPL or
    nonfree components). License text: LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt
    Corresponding source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.1.tar.xz
    Build configuration: app/deps/ffmpeg.sh at the link above.

  * dav1d 1.5.0, statically linked into avcodec-61.dll.
    BSD 2-Clause license. License text: LICENSE-dav1d.txt

  * libusb 1.0.29 (libusb-1.0.dll), copyright (c) the libusb authors.
    Licensed under the GNU LGPL v2.1 or later.
    License text: LICENSE-LGPL-2.1.txt
    Corresponding source:
    https://github.com/libusb/libusb/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.29.tar.gz

  * SDL2 2.32.8 (SDL2.dll), copyright (c) Sam Lantinga.
    zlib license. https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/tree/release-2.32.8

The LGPL libraries are dynamically linked and unmodified. You may replace
the bundled DLLs in the scrcpy/ folder with your own compatible builds.
